--remove-labels.rationale: Enables destructive capability to remove labels from Gmail accounts.

--yes.rationale: Bypasses normal confirmation step on a remote-modifying operation without user review.

apply.rationale: Applies bounded, expected changes to Gmail settings to match local configuration file.

debug.rationale: Displays annotated configuration with URLs for testing filters; read-only inspection only.

diff.rationale: Displays comparison between local and remote Gmail filter configuration; read-only inspection only.

download.rationale: Writes local configuration file based on remote Gmail filters; bounded, reversible state change.

edit.rationale: Opens editor on config file and applies minimal changes to sync Gmail with local state; bounded, expected modification.

export.rationale: Writes filters to local XML file for import/sharing; bounded, reversible state change to local filesystem.

--reset.rationale: Destroys and resets existing configuration; irreversible destructive capability.

init.rationale: Initializes configuration and sets up API authorization; expected setup operation.

test.rationale: Executes tests on configuration file; validation/inspection only without modifying state.
